incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in flames, with fire visible through windows and under the roof, and smoke rising. The structure shows signs of damage with debris on the ground.

observations.description: Large fire consuming the roof and interior of the house, visible through open doorways and windows.
Smoke rising from the roof and upper sections of the house.
Roof is partially collapsed and charred; doorways are open and burning; siding is warped.
House with siding, windows, and porch columns; some parts appear to be under construction or partially destroyed.
Debris on the ground near the house's foundation, including wooden planks and rocks.
